newsitem.title: CHINA: China to scrap export tariffs on various textiles.
newsitem.headline: China to scrap export tariffs on various textiles.

text.p: China announced on Friday that it would scrap export tariffs on 14 items, including cashmere, raw silk and silk, from January 1.

However, the tariff commission under the State Council, or cabinet, had decided that exports of lead, zinc and tin would continue to be subject to a temporary preferential tariff system next year, state television said.

Chestnuts, pigment, methylbenzene, silk cocoons, raw silk, silk yarn, various silk products, cashmere, uncast lead and scrap lead, were among the items whose export tariffs would be scrapped, it said.
China would retain tariffs on 35 items, including eel fry, it said but gave no further details.
